risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and generally transparent, reporting sales, earnings, cash flow, debt, margins, inventory turnover, and sensitivity to shrink assumptions. Risk factors include lower inventory turnover, supply-chain and transportation costs, shrink pressure, inflation-driven transaction declines, higher interest expense, and substantial debt-funded shareholder distributions. Overall tone remains confident and performance-oriented, with standard caveats around non-GAAP measures and accounting estimates.
